name: mghal-official-website
description: Bilingual M.GH.AL official static website — quality and TypeScript tooling

scripts.check:generated: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const n of ['credentials.js','accessibility.js','project-cards.js']){const a=fs.readFileSync('dist/scripts/'+n,'utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('assets/'+n,'utf8');if(a!==b){console.error('Generated asset is stale: '+n);process.exitCode=1}}"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:scripts && npm run sync:generated && npm run check:generated && npm run prepare:site && npm run test:project-pages && node --check assets/social-engagement.js && node --check assets/article-page.js && node --check assets/visitor-tracking.js && node scripts/test-public-content.mjs && node --check assets/admin.js && node scripts/test-admin-panel.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run build && npm run audit:html && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:design && npm run audit:corporate-ui && npm run audit:pwa && npm run audit:credentials && npm run test:unit && npm run test:project-pages && npm run test:admin
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/test-certificate-sync.mjs && node scripts/test-project-api-sync.mjs && node scripts/test-credentials.mjs && node scripts/test-accessibility.mjs && node scripts/test-project-cards.mjs && node scripts/test-navigation.mjs && node scripts/test-homepage.mjs && node scripts/test-public-content.mjs && node scripts/test-showcase-pages.mjs
scripts.prepare:site: node scripts/generate-project-pages.mjs && python3 scripts/generate-showcase-pages.py && node scripts/prepare-static-output.mjs && npm run audit:public-output
